pterodactyl.key: Your Pterodactyl API key with all permissions

sso.sharedSecret: Change this to a strong random string matching panel HELIACTYL_SSO_SHARED_SECRET

website.secret: Default Secret (Change this to any string you want)

api.code: Default API Key (Change this to any string you want)

joinguild._comment: The Discord bot must be in these servers and have invite permissions. Automatic guild joining will not work unless role packages are configured correctly. You can always just set it to a random role & package so that only this works.

giverole._comment: Auto-join must be enabled for this to work - or the user must already be in your Discord. This will give the user a role when they login.

passwordgenerator.note: Use this to disable registering on Heliactyl.

oauth2._comment: Go to https://discord.dev/ and create an application to set up OAuth2. This is required for Heliactyl to work. You must also set the redirect URL to the link below.

ip._note: Anti-alt checks will not work if you are proxying through Cloudflare. This is due to the fact that Cloudflare does not pass the real IP address through the headers. If you are using Cloudflare, please disable this feature.

default.description: Basic hosting tier with shared resources

rolePackages.note: This allows you to set a different plan/package to people who have a specific role however this requires the Discord bot to be configured and functioning. This is mainly used for Boost rewards.

afk._note: This is the 2nd-generation version of Heliactyl's AFK system. Please report any bugs on the GitHub (github.com/heliactyloss/heliactyl). Thank you.

antivpn.note: For this to work, generate an API Key on https://proxycheck.io/. If you do not put a key, Heliactyl will automatically disable anti-VPN.

whitelist.note: This allows only specific people to be able to login to the Heliactyl dashboard. This does not affect your Panel.

logging._note: This is the 2nd-generation version of Heliactyl's logging system. Please report any bugs on the GitHub (github.com/heliactyloss/heliactyl). Thank you.

turnstile.note: Cloudflare Turnstile protects AFK page from bots. Get keys at https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile
